title: BigP3BCI Study B — 6x6 checkerboard, multi-session (19 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset contains P300-based brain-computer interface speller recordings from 19 participants (Study B of bigP3BCI), collected across 8 sessions each. EEG was recorded from 16 channels at 256 Hz using a g.USBamp while participants attended to target characters in a 6x6 checkerboard-style grid, with target and non-target flashes annotated using HED. The data are a MOABB-derived version of the PhysioNet bigP3BCI collection and support P300 detection and speller benchmarking.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 16 channels (standard 10-20 montage) with a g.USBamp (g.tec) at 256 Hz in a laboratory setting, with a 60 Hz line frequency. Participants used a P300 speller with a 6x6 character grid and online feedback, using a calibration-then-test protocol. Events were labeled Target and NonTarget, with trial epochs of 0 to 1.0 s.
